name: Snap Marching Cubes
definition: An algorithm that modifies the scalar field to snap isosurface vertices close to grid vertices onto those grid vertices, improving mesh quality by avoiding small angles, at the cost of potential topological changes.
summary: Snap Marching Cubes is a non-adaptive isosurface extraction algorithm that improves mesh quality by snapping vertices to grid points, reducing triangle count and eliminating noisy angles.
